description: Manages the profile and personal information for users within the system, including their contact details, settings, roles, and permissions.

endpoints.name: UpdateProfile
endpoints.description: Updates the current user's profile information.

profile.description: Updated profile model containing new information

example_uses: Update my profile with my new contact details.
I need to change my address in my user profile.
Can you help me update my personal information?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when an authenticated user wants to modify their own profile details such as name, contact information, or other personal attributes.

endpoints.name: UpdateUserInfo
endpoints.description: Updates current user's information and profile settings.

userInfo.description: Updated user information object containing profile changes

example_uses: I want to update my user settings.
Can I change my user preferences?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to update a broader set of user information and settings, potentially including profile details, preferences, or other user-specific configurations.

endpoints.name: GetUserProfileDetails
endpoints.description: Retrieves comprehensive current user information including profile, roles, permissions, organizational settings, and user preferences. Supports both authenticated user lookup and explicit email parameter for administrative purposes.

email.description: Optional specific email to get user info for (if not provided, uses current authenticated user)

example_uses: Get my current user profile details.
Show me all the information associated with my account.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch all available information about the current authenticated user, or to retrieve details for a specific user by providing their email address (requires appropriate administrative permissions).
